description.name: Attach Ice 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Synchro Mode

description.name: Revived Discipline Mode
description.text: Restores HP for 100% of the user's maximum HP and grants [Instant ATB 3] and [Instant Cast 3] when HP fall below 20%, removed after triggering
